text: Great Mat. Really comfy to stand on and I felt very secure on it with no fear of slipping.  Great purchase.

product_metadata.title: AmazerBath Bath Tub Mat, Larger Suction Cups Bath Mats with Strong Grip, Safe TPE Material, Machine Washable, Non-Slip Shower Mats for Bathroom, 39 x 16 Inches (Blue)
features: Extra strong grip: This mat features 200 bigger powerful suction cups which make the suction power twice as strong as normal mats. The subtle textured pattern on the surface keeps you from slipping or falling in the bathtub.
Durable material: Unlike smelly PVC bath mats, this mat is made of durable and safe TPE material which is healthy. The non-slip surface is soft against skin and won't cause pain to your feet.

Extra large size: Large bathtub mat 39 x 16 inches will cover most length of tub and feels great on the feet. Great for bathtub and shower stalls in homes, gyms, hospitals, hotels, and other living facilities.
Good drainage: The drain holes on the mat drain water out quickly and keep the mat dry and clean. Machine washable and easy to clean. Just throw it in the washing machine and let it air dry.

Good to know: Mat only attaches to smooth clean surfaces instead of textured, tiled or non-smooth surfaces. To avoid falls, please moisten the tub with a little bit of water before filling the tub mat, then press the bath mat with your hands to secure suction cups tightly on the smooth bathtub.
